metadata.description: Semantic code search and architecture understanding for LingoLinq-AAC

Development PostgreSQL access, scoped to this repo only. Write-capable (the query tool can run writes/DDL). Before approving on first load, self-verify YOUR OWN local `lingolinq-development` DB holds no real student/patient rows -- Scot confirmed his was synthetic-only on 2026-06-14, but that confirmation is per-machine and does not carry over to any other checkout or clone. If your local DB is ever seeded from prod or real rows, treat this server as a regulated-data surface and do not approve it.
